visual_audit.extraction_warning: Whole-document pdftotext reports malformed-stream warnings elsewhere. Selected numerical rows and relevant assumptions were verified visually; no claim is made that all 684 pages were audited.

conventions.uncertainty_interpretation: Evaluator-assigned multiplicative envelopes. Section 1.2 describes an approximate standard-deviation interpretation without rigorous statistical derivation; Section 2.6 discusses a two-sigma coverage objective. Neither establishes an exact confidence probability or independent parameter distributions.
conventions.independence: The two limiting coefficients of a reaction are not independent calibration units. No independent errors are assigned to each pressure or temperature point.

scientific_cautions: These are evaluated recommendations, partly theory-assisted or extrapolated, not eight independent experimental measurements.
H+O2 collider sensitivity includes water; an air recommendation is not an N2-only or humid-gas reference.
OH+OH association is not total OH loss; the pressure-independent H2O+O channel and substantial discrepancies in the cited association measurements remain relevant.
Ethyl+O2 uses an evaluated air correction rather than directly measured air data at every pressure.
The published 0.6 broadening expression can define an evaluated-model comparator. Generated points would not become independently measured finite-pressure data or a locked holdout.
This audit supplies no electronic-structure error model, capture potential, energy-transfer calibration or mechanism-coverage calibration for STORCA.

development_amendment.change: Eight 300 K reference factors now use the published temperature correction rather than copying f(298). Added explicit non-probabilistic reference semantics.
